title: New dish from a recipe

entry.lead: Take a picture of the recipe, paste a link, or type the ingredients. We look every ingredient up and work out the carbs.
entry.photo: Take a picture of the recipe
entry.textPlaceholder: Type e.g. 500 g minced beef, 2 tins of chopped tomatoes …
entry.aiOff: Picture and text need AI help, which is off here. A link to a recipe still works.
